method: Postprocess already measured fresh-source leaf-root distances to terminal centerlines. The 384 near-axis roots are separated from the next proximal root by an observed 6x distance gap; midpoint is a grouping aid, not an invented size acceptance requirement.
initial_probe_note: The initial arbitrary 0.002m probe was too narrow and returned zero. It is retained, not misrepresented as a model failure. Results are stable for thresholds from0.0026 to0.0153m.
